description.value:
Your might matches that of legendary champions.

You become proficient in Strength saving throws; if you already had that proficiency, you gain expertise in it instead.

You can wield two-handed weapons you're proficient with as though they lacked the two-handed property.

When a melee weapon attack you make misses, the target still takes damage equal to your Strength modifier, of the same type the weapon would have dealt.
